meta.note: Mirrors src/styles/globals.css; src/test/design-system-docs.test.ts fails when they drift.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas behind the chat and the empty states; the marketing page background. Today's code paints it #000000 or #0a0a0a.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Sidebar, top bar and dialog bodies: chrome one step above `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Composer, cards (permission requests, tool output) and text inputs.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns and popovers; always with `border` and `shadow-popover`.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and selected state of rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind a dialog.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: dividers, card and menu edges. Decorative, so it does not carry meaning on its own.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that must be seen: text inputs, the outline button, an editable field. At least 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Headings, the active session, the text you are typing. On every surface.

tokens.name: fg-secondary
tokens.usage: Message body and button labels, on every surface.

tokens.name: fg-muted
tokens.usage: Icons, secondary labels and inactive tabs, on every surface.

tokens.name: fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints, timestamps, placeholders, file paths. Replaces neutral-500, which fell below 4.5:1. Avoid on `surface-hover`.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action in a view: Send, Allow, Download. Inverted against the theme.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on `primary`.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icon on `primary`.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Solid 1px keyboard focus ring with a 1px offset, on every control. Replaces the faint amber ring.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: An agent working (pulsing dot), a check passed, a line added. Always paired with a label or tooltip.

tokens.name: status-attention
tokens.usage: An agent waiting on you: a permission request, a pending check, an unsaved choice.

tokens.name: status-unread
tokens.usage: A session that finished while you were elsewhere.

tokens.name: status-merged
tokens.usage: A merged pull request. 7.5:1 on `bg` in dark, 6.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions: Delete, Deny, a failed check, a line removed.

tokens.name: danger-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of a destructive button and an error banner; text on it is `danger`.

tokens.name: attention-surface
tokens.usage: Fill of a permission request card; text on it is `fg` and `fg-secondary`.

tokens.name: attention-border
tokens.usage: Edge of a permission request card, all four sides.

tokens.name: diff-added
tokens.usage: Background of an added line in a diff.

tokens.name: diff-removed
tokens.usage: Background of a removed line in a diff.

tokens.name: terminal-bg
tokens.usage: Terminal and its empty state. Dark in both themes: agents' ANSI colors are tuned for a dark ground.

tokens.name: terminal-fg-subtle
tokens.usage: Hints on `terminal-bg`, in both themes. `fg-subtle` turns dark in light mode and would vanish there.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero headline on the landing page. Two lines at most.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section headlines on the landing page.
styles.sample: Bring the agent you already use.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The `zorvo` wordmark only, always lowercase, beside the symbol.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles: onboarding steps, an empty workspace.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Refactor the session list so archived sessions stay pinned.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Default UI text: buttons, menus, rows, labels. The most used style.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Hints, timestamps, counts and secondary metadata.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges and tiny labels; never for sentences.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Terminal, diffs, tool output and code blocks.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: File paths, branch names and PR numbers inside UI text.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Between a badge and its text; nudges.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside icon buttons (p-1); between tightly related items.

tokens.name: space-1.5
tokens.usage: Icon to label in buttons and chips; vertical padding of rows and buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a toolbar or row.

tokens.name: space-2.5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of compact buttons and menu items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons; composer padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; the gap between card sections.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Dialog padding and the gap between dialog sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page gutters and the gap between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Menu items, small inline buttons, code chips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Icon buttons, attachment chips, session rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Buttons, dropdown triggers, menus.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Composer, cards and dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots only.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns and the composer, which float over content.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the `overlay` scrim.

tokens.name: size-dot
tokens.usage: Status dot diameter.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Icons inside buttons, rows and menus (Lucide, 1.75 stroke).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Height and width of icon buttons, the send button and toolbar controls.
